summary: UserIgnoredPR manages the functionality for users to ignore Placement Requests within a welcome screen context. It tracks ignore actions, durations, restoration dates, and allows searching, adding, and deleting such records for users.
purpose: To allow system users to temporarily ignore Placement Requests (PRs) presented in a welcome screen, record the details of ignored PRs, and provide workflows for searching, adding, and deleting these records. It also manages restoration dates and their presentation.

workflows.name: Search UserIgnoredPRs
steps: Receive welcomeScreenStat and optional sort expression.
Parse sort expression and determine order (asc/desc).
Add parameters: SessionID, WelcomeScreenStat, Sort, Asc.
Execute DB procedure and fetch records.
For each record, create UserIgnoredPR entity and populate fields.
Format restoration date; if it matches tomorrow, set flag and formatted value appropriately.

workflows.name: Add UserIgnoredPR
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, WelcomeScreenStat, PlacementRequestDestinationID, NumDays.

workflows.name: Delete UserIgnoredPR Stat
steps: Execute DB procedure to delete record.

business_rules: RestorationDateFormatted is set to a special value if RestorationDate is tomorrow.
Ignored PRs are tracked by user, stat, destination, and duration.
Deletion is explicit via stat and placement request destination.
validations: RestorationDate comparison against DateTime.Today.AddDays(1) to determine if the restoration is tomorrow.
DateIgnored is checked for date match (year, month, day) against restoration date.
conditions: If RestorationDate is tomorrow, RestorationDateIsTomorrow is true and RestorationDateFormatted is set to Resources.Next_day.
Otherwise, RestorationDateIsTomorrow is false and RestorationDateFormatted uses DateFormatter.FormatDateShort.
system_behavior: System tracks ignored PRs per user and context.
System displays restoration date as formatted label; if tomorrow, uses special text.
Provides business workflow APIs for search, add, and delete actions.
dependencies: Resources.Next_day for special restoration date display.
exceptions: If DB reader is null (no results), no entries are processed.
If restoration date is not a valid date, formatted value may fallback.
